schema_amendments.description: DS-014 closes TD-007. Migration 0003 ALTERs the 4 existing S1 created_at columns from TIMESTAMP (S1 ORM emitted plain TIMESTAMP) to TIMESTAMPTZ. The S1 schema.json prose already documented TIMESTAMPTZ — S2 brings the implementation into alignment with that prose.

entities.name: tbl_inward_header

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: purchase_date
fields.description: Date of the inward purchase. Service-validated: today() - 7 <= purchase_date <= today() per AC-020 (ERR-001) and AC-021 (ERR-002).

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_supplier_master.supplier_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT).

fields.name: place
fields.description: Snapshot of supplier.place at save time per DS-013. Read-only on the form (AC-022); not propagated retroactively when the master changes.

fields.name: entered_by_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_staff_master.staff_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT). Must reference an active staff at save time (service-level check).

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-default insert timestamp via TimestampMixin (with DS-014 TIMESTAMPTZ upgrade).

indexes: INDEX ix_inward_header_purchase_date ON (purchase_date) — supports S3 Stock Dashboard date filtering.

relationships.direction_note: Each header references one staff member.

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES tbl_supplier_master(supplier_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (entered_by_id) REFERENCES tbl_staff_master(staff_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

entities.name: tbl_inward_line

fields.name: line_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_inward_header.header_id (ON DELETE CASCADE — DB-level mirror of the ORM cascade for safety).

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_trading_design_master.design_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT). Must reference an active design at save time (service-level).

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_grade_master.grade_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT). Service enforces (design_id, grade_id) is in active design_grade_map (AC-023).

fields.name: nos
fields.description: Quantity inward. CHECK(nos > 0) per AC-024 (ERR-007). Zero / blank rows are stripped by the service before insert per AC-025 (RULE-017).

indexes: INDEX ix_inward_line_header ON (header_id) — supports header detail fetch.
INDEX ix_inward_line_dgd ON (design_id, grade_id, header_id) — supports per-(design,grade) backfill / forward-recompute reads.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (header_id) REFERENCES tbl_inward_header(header_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (design_id) REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(design_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(grade_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (nos > 0) — enforces AC-024 at the DB level (defense-in-depth alongside Pydantic).

entities.name: tbl_sales_header

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: sales_date
fields.description: Service-validated identically to inward.purchase_date (AC-028 / ERR-001 / ERR-002).

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_dealer_master.dealer_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT).

fields.name: place
fields.description: Snapshot of dealer.place at save time per DS-013 (AC-029).

fields.name: loading_staff_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_staff_master.staff_id (RESTRICT). Required, active per AC-030.

fields.name: verified_by_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_staff_master.staff_id (RESTRICT). Required, active per AC-030. Distinct logical role from loading_staff_id but the DB has no rule that they must differ — both can be the same staff member if the business chooses.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: TimestampMixin (DS-014).

indexes: INDEX ix_sales_header_sales_date ON (sales_date) — supports S3 Sales Report date-range filter and Stock Dashboard.
INDEX ix_sales_header_dealer ON (dealer_id) — supports S3 Sales Report dealer filter (AC-046).
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (dealer_id) REFERENCES tbl_dealer_master(dealer_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (loading_staff_id) REFERENCES tbl_staff_master(staff_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (verified_by_id) REFERENCES tbl_staff_master(staff_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

entities.name: tbl_sales_line

fields.name: line_id
fields.description: Surrogate PK.

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_sales_header.header_id (ON DELETE CASCADE).

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_trading_design_master (RESTRICT).

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_grade_master (RESTRICT). (design_id, grade_id) must be in active design_grade_map (AC-031).

fields.name: nos
fields.description: Quantity sold. CHECK(nos > 0) per AC-032.

indexes: INDEX ix_sales_line_dgd ON (design_id, grade_id, header_id) — supports S3 Consolidation Report (GROUP BY design, grade) and Sales Report design filter.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (header_id) REFERENCES tbl_sales_header(header_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (design_id) REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(design_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(grade_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (nos > 0)

entities.name: tbl_adjustment_header

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: Surrogate PK.

fields.name: stock_date
fields.description: Date the physical stock was taken. Per AC-035 must be <= entry_date (ERR-010).

fields.name: entry_date
fields.description: Date the form was submitted. Used as txn_date for the resulting ledger rows (since adjustments represent the value at stock_date applied to the ledger at entry_date).

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_trading_design_master (RESTRICT). EXACTLY one design per adjustment per AC-034 — enforced by having the design on the header (not the line). Service blocks save if design has no active grade combinations (ERR-012 / AC-040).

fields.name: entered_by_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_staff_master.staff_id (RESTRICT). Required.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: TimestampMixin (DS-014).

indexes: INDEX ix_adjustment_header_design_stock_date ON (design_id, stock_date) — supports re-reading the latest adjustment for a (design, stock_date) pair if needed.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (design_id) REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(design_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (entered_by_id) REFERENCES tbl_staff_master(staff_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (stock_date <= entry_date) — enforces AC-035 (ERR-010) at the DB level.

entities.name: tbl_adjustment_line

fields.name: line_id
fields.description: Surrogate PK.

fields.name: header_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_adjustment_header.header_id (ON DELETE CASCADE).

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_grade_master (RESTRICT). The header's design_id pairs with this grade_id to form the (design, grade) key for the ledger write.

fields.name: software_cb
fields.description: Software closing balance as of header.stock_date per AC-036. Snapshotted by the service at save time via domain.stock.closing_balance(design, grade, stock_date). Persisted (not GENERATED) so it survives subsequent ledger recomputes.

fields.name: physical_cb
fields.description: User-entered physical count. CHECK(physical_cb >= 0) per AC-037 — zero is valid.

fields.name: difference
fields.description: Signed delta = physical_cb - software_cb per AC-038. Can be negative. Persisted (not GENERATED) so it remains the historical record of what was applied to the ledger even if software_cb is later re-derived differently.

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (header_id) REFERENCES tbl_adjustment_header(header_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(grade_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (physical_cb >= 0)

entities.name: tbl_stock_ledger

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: Surrogate PK. Append-only sequence; back-dated transactions still get a new ledger_id but the (txn_date, ledger_id DESC) ordering means later inserts win ties when txn_dates are equal.

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_trading_design_master (RESTRICT).

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK -> tbl_grade_master (RESTRICT).

fields.name: txn_date
fields.description: The business date the row represents — purchase_date / sales_date / adjustment.entry_date depending on source_type.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: One of: 'inward', 'sale', 'adjustment'. Tracks which form created this ledger row for audit + S3 reporting.

fields.name: source_header_id
fields.description: FK reference back to the source header (inward/sales/adjustment_header.header_id). Nullable to allow synthetic future entries (none in V1). Per DS-008 the master is soft-deleted not hard-deleted, so this never dangles in V1.

fields.name: source_line_id
fields.description: FK reference back to the source line. Nullable for same reason as source_header_id.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: Signed quantity change: +nos for inward, -nos for sale, +difference for adjustment (can be negative). Sum of all deltas up to and including a row = running_balance at that row (loop invariant).

fields.name: running_balance
fields.description: Materialized running balance per DS-003. After a back-dated insert, every later row for (design_id, grade_id) has its running_balance updated by domain.stock._recompute_forward.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Insert timestamp via TimestampMixin (DS-014).

indexes: INDEX ix_stock_ledger_dgt ON (design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) — single composite index supporting (a) closing_balance lookup as_of_date (LIMIT 1 lookup), (b) latest_for_design_grade for SELECT FOR UPDATE (DS-002), (c) rows_after for _recompute_forward.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (design_id) REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(design_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(grade_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (source_type IN ('inward', 'sale', 'adjustment'))
design_notes: Concurrency (DS-002): every insert acquires SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the latest (design_id, grade_id) row first.
Carry-forward (DS-004): opening_balance(month_first) = running_balance of latest row where txn_date < month_first; 0 if none.
Back-date support (DS-003): bounded by AC-021 7-day window per (design, grade) — small linear scan.

operations_in_order: ALTER TABLE tbl_supplier_master ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE tbl_staff_master ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE tbl_dealer_master ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE tbl_trading_design_master ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
CREATE TABLE tbl_inward_header, tbl_sales_header, tbl_adjustment_header (FK parents first)
CREATE TABLE tbl_inward_line, tbl_sales_line, tbl_adjustment_line (FK children)
CREATE INDEX ix_stock_ledger_dgt + the supporting indexes on all new tables
migration_plan.downgrade_order: drop indexes -> drop tables in reverse FK dependency -> revert TIMESTAMPTZ back to TIMESTAMP on the 4 S1 tables
